scope: Sewn stiff petticoat contact approximation, not full multilayer tulle dynamics

collision.implementationHint: A pelvis-following kinematic/AnimatableBody with local convex subshapes. Rebase each modelRestVertex with inverse(actual imported pelvis global rest); body transform follows actual pelvis global pose.

limitations: Piecewise convex contact represents sewn stiff boning and an inner skirt, not free multilayer tulle.
Small inward arc-chord filling occurs within each local convex panel; the skirt center is hollow.
Imported actual Skeleton global rest is authoritative for rebasing; do not add pelvis translation twice.
Outer garment bending, damping and collision response remain independent runtime responsibilities.
